mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES stays less negative for several weeks, commuting traffic returns first and then spills into nearby retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next month. The current sequence from -30.1 to -11.9 suggests a demand recovery signal that should carry into retail if the workplace rebound persists.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved sharply from t-3w to t-0w while TRANSIT remained deeply negative

The recent plunge in PARKS to -30.4 should therefore produce a short-lag increase in RETAIL_REC if weather or other outdoor constraints continue to suppress park visits.

failure_condition: Reject this hypothesis if RETAIL_REC does not rise within 1 week after PARKS falls below -20, or if RETAIL_REC falls further while PARKS remains depressed.
